title: St. Clair River Fireworks.wav by Ambient-X
author: Ambient-X
sourceDescription: 4th of July firework celebration from the middle of a crowd at a Palmer Park along side the St. Clair River. The St. Clair river is part of the Great Lakes system. All of the water from Lake Michigan, Lake Superior & Lake Huron flow through the St. Clair River before getting to the other 2 great lakes, then eventually the Atlantic Ocean. The Fireworks were discharged from a barge in the shipping channel that separates the USA and Canada. At the beginning of the recording the crowd is asked to do a count down, so the people of the barge know when to light off the fireworks.
